_comment: Ways the house is used beyond a stay. Each entry renders twice: as a teaser card in the Gatherings section of index.html (tag/title/teaser) and as a full row on events.html (eyebrow/heading/body/points/ctaLabel). Rows alternate media left/right automatically. `enquiry` is the prefilled WhatsApp message; it is written out rather than derived from `heading`, because the headings are editorial and read badly inside a sentence.

items.title: Supper Club
items.teaser: An evening of curated, multi-course Malabar dishes cooked in the heritage kitchen and served at a shared table.
items.heading: An evening at the shared table
items.body: Our supper club is a curated, multi-course dinner drawn from Kasaragod’s home kitchens - cooked on the heritage stove and served at one long table. A slow evening of regional dishes, most of which never made it to a restaurant menu.
items.alt: A supper club dinner laid out at the shared table
items.enquiry: Hi, I'd like to enquire about the supper club at Thalathoor. Preferred dates:

items.title: Retreats & get-togethers
items.teaser: Offsites, reunions and intimate celebrations - the whole house and grounds for your group.
items.heading: Retreats, offsites & get-togethers
items.body: Take the whole house for an offsite, a reunion or a milestone celebration. Meals, rooms and the grounds are yours, with the quiet and the green that the everyday city event never has.
points: Exclusive use of the house & grounds
All meals from the heritage kitchen
items.alt: Guests gathered for a get-together at the house
items.enquiry: Hi, I'd like to enquire about a retreat or private get-together at Thalathoor. Dates: / Number of guests:

items.title: Destination weddings & Haldi
items.teaser: Intimate ceremonies, haldi mornings and receptions set in the courtyard and gardens.
items.heading: Destination weddings & Haldi
items.body: Intimate ceremonies, haldi mornings and receptions set in the courtyard and gardens. A heritage backdrop for the day, with food and hospitality handled by the family.
items.alt: A wedding celebration in the courtyard
items.enquiry: Hi, I'd like to enquire about a wedding or haldi at Thalathoor. Dates: / Number of guests:

items.title: Photo & film shoots
items.teaser: Verandahs, red oxide floors, teakwood and old doorways - the house photographs the way it looks, with no set dressing.
items.heading: A location that needs no set dressing
items.body: The house is open for portrait, fashion, wedding and editorial shoots. Red oxide floors, teakwood ceilings, carved doorways, the courtyard and the verandah - plus paddy fields, an arecanut plantation and the pond within the grounds. Shoots can run alongside a stay or as a day visit.
points: Natural light through the day; green on every side
Meals from the heritage kitchen on request
Day visits or shoots alongside a stay
items.alt: A portrait session in the heritage house, against a dark doorway and red oxide floor
items.enquiry: Hi, I'd like to enquire about a photoshoot at Thalathoor. Type of shoot: / Preferred dates: / Crew size:
